BL-1472 — A bounce revert plus its reapply on the reviewing branch are untagged touches on another ticket's paths, and own-paths keeps a path with any untagged touch for the landing ticket (BL-1315), so after QA restored BL-1348's merge on 2026-09-07 the land step credited BL-1348's unapproved ruling-B code and tests to BL-1463 as its own, silently; a revert or reapply commit is transparent to path attribution - the paths it undoes or redoes belong to the commits it undoes or redoes
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-07 by the specifier on QA's note, the same pass, with
BL-1473 (delivered set) and BL-1474 (replay reason). The QA prompt
gained the interim hand review of the own-path set with this mint.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. What is FIRM: a revert or reapply commit contributes no owner and no untagged touch of its own - the paths it undoes or redoes stay attributed to the commits it undoe…
BL-1472 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1472" (or "reject BL-1472 <reason>") to act.
